name: Σ theme
author: Project Σ
description: The app's own design, finished: the material of its chat windows carried through every surface (Inter throughout, hairline edges lit along the top, quiet depth), a calm ground of slowly drifting light, character details opening under a banner lit by their portrait, and conversations that lean toward their character's colour. Five palettes and palettes of your own; every part of the layout, the type and the motion can be switched back to a plainer form in its section. Your own theme settings and custom CSS still apply on top. Ships off; switch it on to use it.
